modules.name: clear_tree_pillar
modules.description: Clears a whole tree (its logs and leaves, within 3 blocks of the trunk) including parts too high to reach: picks the tree trunk nearest the bot, breaks what it can reach from the ground, then stands in the trunk column and pillars up with blocks from the inventory (dirt/cobble/planks/logs), breaking everything in reach at each level. Then it climbs down one block at a time by breaking the pillar under itself (filling any gap below first, so it never falls more than 1 block), leaving no placed blocks. Needs a few placeable blocks in the inventory.

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: tree_at_30_cleared
modules.description: No *_log or *_leaves seen within 3 blocks horizontally of the tree at [30,-60,-12] (y -61..-50), bot within 6 blocks of the trunk column.
modules.code: (s) => { const c = [30, -57, -12]; if (dist(s.self.pos, c) > 6) return false; const globs = ["*_log", "*_leaves"]; const suf = globs.map(g => g.slice(1)); const isTree = (n) => suf.some(x => n.endsWith(x)); for (const n of Object.keys(s.blocks)) { if (!isTree(n)) continue; for (const p of s.blocks[n]) { if (Math.abs(p[0] - 30) <= 3 && Math.abs(p[2] + 12) <= 3 && p[1] >= -61 && p[1] <= -50) return false; } } if ((s.crowded || []).some(isTree)) return false; return true; }

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: has_wooden_pickaxe
modules.description: The bot holds at least one wooden pickaxe in its inventory.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest

modules.name: pickaxe_deposited
modules.description: Bot is next to a seen chest and no longer carries a wooden pickaxe (it was crafted in the previous step, so it went into the chest).
modules.code: (s) => { const c = (s.blocks && s.blocks.chest) || []; if (c.length === 0) return false; return dist(s.self.pos, c[0]) <= 4 && count(s, "wooden_pickaxe") === 0; }

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest
